name: krl-helper
description: Language support and productivity tools for KUKA Robot Language (KRL) in Visual Studio Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Liest KRL-Projektdateien (.src/.dat/.sub) im Workspace für Navigation und Diagnostik.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Projektübergreifende Navigation/Diagnostik benötigt Dateizugriff und ist in virtuellen Workspaces eingeschränkt.

krlHelper.diagnostics.localVariablePrefi.description: Literal prefixes for variables that need a visible declaration, preferring the current module before explicit project-global declarations. Prefix matching is case-insensitive.

krlHelper.diagnostics.globalVariablePref.description: Literal prefixes for variables that must be declared in the global project declaration space. These take precedence over local prefixes.

krlHelper.diagnostics.inputAliasPrefixes.description: Literal prefixes for $IN aliases that must be declared in $config.dat. Prefix matching is case-insensitive.

krlHelper.diagnostics.outputAliasPrefixe.description: Literal prefixes for $OUT aliases that must be declared in $config.dat. Prefix matching is case-insensitive.
